checkin_events_shape.name: checkin_events_shape
checkin_events_shape.value:
("checkin_events"."kind" = 'checkin' and "checkin_events"."pax" >= 1 and "checkin_events"."method" is not null and "checkin_events"."target_id" is null)
        or ("checkin_events"."kind" = 'undo' and "checkin_events"."target_id" is not null)
        or ("checkin_events"."kind" = 'set_pax' and "checkin_events"."target_id" is not null and "checkin_events"."pax" >= 1)

events_time_order.name: events_time_order
events_time_order.value: "events"."starts_at" is null or "events"."ends_at" is null or "events"."ends_at" >= "events"."starts_at"

guests_has_contact.name: guests_has_contact
guests_has_contact.value: "guests"."source" = 'walkin' or "guests"."phone" is not null or "guests"."instagram" is not null

received_gifts_amount_valid.name: received_gifts_amount_valid
received_gifts_amount_valid.value:
("received_gifts"."kind" = 'barang' and "received_gifts"."item_description" is not null)
        or ("received_gifts"."kind" <> 'barang' and "received_gifts"."amount" > 0)
